worldcombat.skill.endeavor.summary: Equalising lunge: drag the target's current HP down onto your own line, dealing exactly (target HP - your HP). The more hurt you are and the healthier the target, the harder it hits; when you are healthier it does nothing at all. The vault form lunges further and slips past the target, at the cost of almost no knockback.
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.description.0: A hit drags the target's current HP down by %1$s: the damage equals (target HP - your HP) at the moment of impact, never below zero; when you are healthier it is zero and the lunge only whiffs.
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.description.1: Prepare %1$s s, then lunge %2$s blocks along the aim (%3$s blocks/tick) with a %4$s block hit radius; the first foe met takes the equalising blow, while terrain stops the lunge early and it misses.
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.description.2: On a solid hit the target is shoved %1$s blocks along the lunge direction (the vault form barely shoves and slips past instead); the shove grows with your missing health and weight, and only happens when the blow actually deals damage.
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.vault.on: Vault: the lunge reaches further and carries you past the target to reposition, but shoves it almost nowhere and takes longer to recover and recharge.
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.vault.off: Plant: the lunge is shorter, shoves the target away, and recovers and recharges sooner.
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.timing: Range %1$s blocks; prepare %2$s s, recover %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, cost %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.use.0: Cut a high-HP target down to your own line
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.use.2: Vault past a foe to reposition
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.preference.va: On: lunge further, slip past the target to reposition, but shove it almost nowhere. Off: shorter lunge, shove the target away, recover and recharge sooner.
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.preference.ai: Only lunge when (target HP - own HP) is at least this share of the target's maximum HP; higher means striking only when clearly behind, avoiding zero-damage lunges.
On: prioritise the lunge when it would empty the target's HP. Off: rank it among ordinary melee candidates.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of lunging; larger makes it chase harder.
When on, the user may leave its post to lunge; when off, it only lunges at what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.growth.0: From level %1$s the shove rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.endeavor.growth.1: From level %1$s the shove rises further to %2$s blocks.
